hero.outcome: Adaptive learning that meets every learner where they are.
hero.description: Adaptive learning agents that tailor pacing and content to each learner across institutions.

problem.title: One pace doesn't fit all
problem.description: A fixed curriculum moves at one speed. Learners who need more time fall behind, and learners who are ahead lose momentum. Instructors can't easily personalize at scale.

outcome.title: Every learner on their own path
outcome.description: Prime Agentic assesses each learner's level and adapts pacing and content, while giving instructors a clear view of progress and the gaps that need attention.

features.title: Adaptive pacing
features.description: Agents adjust the pace of a course to each learner's progress.

features.title: Content recommendations
features.description: Agents suggest the next material that fits where a learner is.

features.title: Progress and gap detection
features.description: Agents surface the specific concepts a learner is struggling with.

features.title: Instructor dashboards
features.description: A cohort-level view of progress, gaps, and intervention points.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Agents assess a learner's starting level and goals.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: Agents recommend content and pacing tailored to that learner.

steps.title: Adapt
steps.description: As the learner progresses, agents adjust the path and flag gaps.

useCases.title: Schools
useCases.description: Personalize pacing across classrooms without extra instructor time.

useCases.title: Universities
useCases.description: Adapt large-enrollment courses to individual preparation levels.

useCases.title: Training providers
useCases.description: Tailor skills programs to each learner's starting point and pace.

faqs.question: When will this be available?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] The platform is in development; availability timing will be announced.

faqs.question: Is there an early access program?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] Early access details are still being defined.

faqs.question: What does this demo show?
faqs.answer: The demo is an illustrative walkthrough of the coordination approach, using a fictional learner and mock progress data.

faqs.question: Does this replace instructors?
faqs.answer: No. Agents adapt pacing and surface gaps; instructors stay central to teaching and support.
